description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various emotions, comparing their relative proportions. The chart is divided into six slices, each representing a distinct emotion. The slices are labeled as Frustration (light blue, 25.1%), Neutral (dark blue, 23.1%), Happiness (purple, 8.1%), Excitement (red, 14.1%), Sadness (orange, 14.7%), and Anger (yellow, 14.9%). The chart includes percentage labels inside each slice, and the slices are arranged in no particular order by size, with Frustration being the largest and Happiness being the smallest. There is no legend or visual emphasis on any particular slice.
